welcomeText:
Install the app and a Start menu shortcut for your user account.

Install location: [INSTALLDIR]

If AI Mon is running, exit it from the tray menu first.
maintenanceText:
Choose Repair to restore the app and its shortcut.
Choose Remove to uninstall the app for this account.

Settings and usage cache will be kept.
Please exit AI Mon first if it is running.
successText:
After installation, find AI Mon in the Start menu to launch it.
After removal, your settings and usage cache are still preserved.
failedText: Close the running app and check install folder permissions, then try again.
userRequired: This package installs for the current user only. Turn off the all-users option.
newerInstalled: A newer version of AI Mon is already installed.
